subject: Close orchestration: sponsor crosswalk + EB boardroom windows
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Claire Wang <claire.wang@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close orchestration: sponsor crosswalk + EB boardroom windows

Claire —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I pulled together a short mutual action plan (MAP) skeleton and a couple of boardroom-window options for the executive briefing (EB) week. Goal: align sponsor map -> confirm EB attendee slate -> lock a 90-minute EB window and one procurement touchpoint by EOW.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the primary exec sponsor and a procurement contact?
- Which of these EB windows work for the Horizon leadership team? (proposed below)

Proposed EB boardroom windows (all PT):
- Option A: Tue 6/29, 09:00–10:30
- Option B: Wed 6/30, 13:30–15:00
- Option C: Thu 7/1, 08:30–10:00

Attached: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (skeleton), sample sponsor crosswalk heatmap. I can iterate to add the account-specific risks and evaluation success criteria once you confirm sponsor names.

If any of the windows are tight, we can do a shorter 60-minute slot plus a follow-up technical deep-dive.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the attendee list and procurement contact and will circulate an updated MAP.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
(jasmine.liu@redwood.com)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB), sponsor_heatmap.png (PNG, 540KB)
From: Claire Wang <claire.wang@horizonhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close orchestration: sponsor crosswalk + EB boardroom windows

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks — this looks helpful. Primary exec sponsor will be Dr. Aaron Mills (CIO). I’m copying Paul Dutra in procurement (paul.dutra@horizonhealth.org) to coordinate the procurement touchpoint.

On EB timing: Option B (Wed 6/30, 13:30–15:00 PT) looks best for the execs, but we may need to shorten to 75 mins to accommodate travel schedules. Can you limit the presentation to 30 minutes of business overview + 20 minutes for product demo + 25 minutes Q&A/next steps?

Also: can you send a one-page success criteria matrix for the MAP (what counts as a successful evaluation) so our stakeholders can pre-align?

Claire
VP, IT Strategy
Horizon Health

Jasmine / Ben —

Thanks Claire — quick internal note:
- I agree with 75–90 min box; propose we structure as: 1) Exec context (15–20), 2) Evaluation outcomes & MAP (15), 3) Product demo (25), 4) Procurement & commercial overview (10), 5) Q&A (10–15).
- Monica — can you prepare the one-page success criteria matrix and a 2-slide procurement touchpoint summary?
- Ben — please prepare a short risk mitigation slide focused on data residency and SLA fallback options.

If Claire confirms Option B, I’ll draft the agenda and a proposed attendee list (exec sponsor, VP of Ops, head of Data Platform, procurement).

Karthik
Head of Sales Strategy

Claire / Paul —

Attached is MAP_v2.xlsx with a one-page success criteria matrix filled in (tab: SuccessCriteria) and a draft agenda (tab: EBAgenda). I also attached a sponsor_heatmap.png that maps the sponsors (Dr. Aaron Mills, VP Ops Simran Kaur, Head of Data Platform Mateo Ruiz) across influence/interest.

Draft EB agenda (75 minutes):
- 13:30–13:50: Exec context + success criteria alignment (Jasmine + Karthik)
- 13:50–14:15: Product demo (Monica)
- 14:15–14:25: Procurement overview (Ben)
- 14:25–14:45: Q&A & next steps (all)

If that works I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed 6/30 13:30–14:45 PT and include the agenda + MAP_v2.xlsx + EB_agenda.docx.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-4832

Claire
